images.prompt:
New Yorker magazine style editorial illustration, single-panel conceptual metaphor. Minimalist thin black hand-drawn ink lines on PURE WHITE background, vast generous negative space, at least 50% empty white. No shading, no gradients, no paper texture, no shadows, no colored fills. Witty, restrained, intelligent. Only accent color is warm orange #F97316. No logos or watermark. Recurring character: 小橙, a TINY minimalist geometric line-drawn figure. Circle head OUTLINE ONLY, two tiny black dot eyes, no mouth or nose. Narrow rectangular body OUTLINE ONLY, thin slightly wobbly stick arms and legs. One small solid orange dot #F97316 on the chest is the ONLY colored accent in the scene. The character actively performs the core action. Its height is roughly 6% of the frame, dwarfed by the monumental objects. All other objects are unfilled thin black ink outlines.
Scene: A TINY 小橙 on the lower right uses a small wrench to take apart an ENORMOUS overcomplicated six-bladed pocket multitool. The huge multitool lies open on a sparse baseline in the lower left; on the lower right are six distinct simple separated components placed neatly beside the figure, with one component still being removed. A physical scene of breaking one overloaded tool into clear usable parts. The tool is at least seven times the character's height. Thin black line art, plain understandable side view, believable mechanical shapes, no diagrams or floating symbols.
Format: 21:9 ULTRA-WIDE landscape cover. Title anchored in the upper-left area with elegant, perfectly legible medium-size dark-gray Chinese sans-serif typography, exact text over two lines: "我怎样把一个面试准备 Skill\n拆成六个 Skills". Keep the illustration in the lower half with ample white breathing room. No other text anywhere.
